quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales 5,267 (100 million yen), up 60.0%; operating income 2,324, up 145.0%; profit before tax 2,305, up 148.8%; net income 1,698, up 144.9% - all record first-half highs, on higher sales and a higher share of high-margin products. Management states AI-related tester demand for high-performance semiconductors expanded sharply, and that as customers pressed harder for deliveries it worked to expand parts procurement and product supply capacity and delivered on time. Test System segment sales 4,780 (up 68.0%), segment profit 2,406 (up 135.1%); Services and Others sales 488 (up 9.3%), segment profit 30 (up 404.6%), including a gain of about 25 on the transfer of part of a business. Overseas sales ratio 98.3%; H1 R&D expenses 354 (100 million yen).
